banner.SANDBOX: SANDBOX · test environment, no real money
banner.STAGING: STAGING · test environment, no real data

auth.title: Depiqo
auth.subtitle: Your rental deposit, safe and clear.
auth.newHereBody: You create your account through your landlord's invitation. Open the link from the email on this phone.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.introRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each recovery code works only once.
mfa.useRecovery: I don't have my app: use a recovery code
mfa.useApp: Use a code from my app
mfa.lostAccess: Lost access to your app and your recovery codes? Contact Depiqo through the website.
mfa.recoveryUsedBody: You have {count} recovery codes left. Create new ones on the website under Security.

lock.title: Depiqo is locked
lock.subtitle: Unlock to see your deposit.
lock.failed: Unlocking did not work. Try again or log in with your password.
lock.usePasswordHint: Signs you out on this device so you can log in again with your email address and password
lock.enablePrompt: Confirm to turn on biometric unlock

update.title: Update the app
update.body: This version of Depiqo is no longer supported. Install the latest version from the App Store or Google Play.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The link is wrong or has expired.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.heading: Your landlord invites you
invite.intro: First check that these details match your lease.
invite.antiPhishingBody: Check that your landlord's name, the address, the amount and the reference match your lease. Does something not match? Do not continue, and call your landlord on a number you look up yourself. Depiqo never asks for your bank code.
invite.confirmDetails: I have checked that the landlord, address, amount and reference match my lease.
invite.confirmRequired: First confirm that the details are correct.
invite.existingBody: Log in with your existing account. Then you accept the invitation.
invite.createBody: Your account will use {email}. Choose a password of at least 12 characters.
invite.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A sentence of a few words is strong and easy to remember.
invite.openWeb: Open the invitation on the website

holding.depiqo: Deposit account in your name through Depiqo
holding.external: With another provider (your landlord arranges this)

deposits.intro: Here you see your deposit and what still needs to happen.
deposits.empty: No deposit is linked to your account yet. Open your landlord's invitation.
deposits.openHint: Opens the details of this deposit

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.sandboxBody: This deposit account is at a sandbox bank. Amounts are simulated; there is no real money.
deposit.interestRate: Interest: {rate} per year, all of it for you.

amount.heading: Amounts
amount.explainer: Four separate amounts. A dash (—) means that amount has not been confirmed yet.

amountNote.no_account: There is no deposit account yet
amountNote.no_payment_reported: The bank has not reported a payment yet
amountNote.sandbox_unconfirmed: Sandbox account: not confirmed by a real bank
amountNote.not_confirmed_by_active_bank: Not confirmed by the active partner bank
amountNote.lock_requested: Requested, not yet confirmed by the bank
amountNote.interest_credited: Credited by the bank, for you
amountNote.guarantee_no_money: No money paid in: a third party guarantees it
amountNote.ocmw_no_money: No money from you: through the social welfare office (OCMW/CPAS)
amountNote.declared_only: Only declared by the manager, not proven
amountNote.outside_depiqo: Outside Depiqo for a deposit held elsewhere

status.payment_received: Payment received, waiting for the bank

display.secured_document: Bank proof from your landlord received

evidenceTenant.declared: Your landlord declares the deposit was received. This has not been proven yet.
evidenceTenant.document: Your landlord sent bank proof. Depiqo has not verified it yet.
evidenceTenant.legal: It has been proven that your deposit is legally secure.

provider.depiqo_account: Deposit account in your name at the partner bank
provider.verhuurder_rekening: In an account of your landlord or property manager
provider.bank_geblokkeerd: In a locked bank account in your name
provider.e_depo: At the Deposit and Consignment Office (e-DEPO)
provider.verzekering_tak26: In a capitalisation contract with an insurer (branch 26)
provider.borggarantie: A third party guarantees it (no money paid in)

assurance.untrusted: Sandbox or another partner: not confirmed by the active bank

location.title: Where your deposit is
location.sandbox: Test environment: this account is not at a real bank.

guarantee.third_party: You have not paid any money. A third party guarantees the deposit. In case of damage, they can recover the amount from you.
guarantee.ocmw: The social welfare office or your local authority guarantees your deposit. You have not paid any money yourself.

guaranteeWarning.action: Contact your landlord and the guarantor.

verify_identity.title: Confirm your identity
verify_identity.description: The partner bank opens the deposit account in your name.

pay.title: Pay your deposit
pay.description: Transfer the amount using exactly these details.

wait.title: Nothing to do right now
wait.description: We will let you know as soon as something changes.

choose_payout_destination.title: Choose where you receive your share
choose_payout_destination.description: To your own account (default) or to your investment account. You can change this until the payout starts.

payoutOwn.title: Payout of your share
payoutOwn.description: By default your share goes to your own account. Want to receive it in your investment account? Choose that on the website, until the payout starts.

release_form.title: Release form
release_form.description: Sign the form together with your landlord and send it to the provider.

payment.title: Payment details
payment.warning: Do the name, amount and reference not match your lease? Do not pay, and call your landlord.
payment.sandbox: Test environment: do not transfer real money here.

payout.title: How the deposit is split
payout.note: Your landlord starts the payout and the bank carries it out. Depiqo never moves money itself.

progress.title: Progress
progress.onHold: Your deposit is temporarily on hold. Your landlord or Depiqo will contact you.

releaseForm.title: Release form
releaseForm.subtitle: PDF to sign with your landlord
releaseForm.explain: Your deposit is held by another provider. Sign this form together with your landlord and send it to the provider, who then releases the deposit.

event.invest_payout_in: Share of your rental deposit received in your investment account

activity.intro: Everything that happened with your deposit and your investments, newest first.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Lease, photos, evidence
documents.openHint: Downloads the document and opens the share menu
documents.addIntro: First choose the kind of document. Then take a photo or pick one.
documents.chooseKindFirst: First choose the kind of document.
documents.cameraDenied: Depiqo may not use the camera. Turn this on in your phone's settings.
documents.typeNotAllowed: This kind of file is not allowed. Choose a JPG or PNG photo.
documents.tooLarge: This photo is too large. The maximum is {max}.
documents.limits: JPG or PNG, at most {max}. Your landlord sees what you add.
documents.closed: This file is closed. You can no longer add documents.
documents.uploadedBody: Your photo is now with the documents of your deposit.

settlement.title: Final settlement
settlement.subtitle: Deductions, agree or object
settlement.none: Your landlord has not proposed a final settlement yet. You will get a notification when it is ready.
settlement.interestNote: Interest on your deposit account, all of it for you.
settlement.note: Depiqo does not decide disputes. You and your landlord reach an agreement together, or a court decides.
settlement.agreeConfirmBody: You agree with this settlement. You get {amount} back. You cannot change this afterwards.
settlement.disputeIntro: Explain what you disagree with. Your landlord receives your explanation and will contact you.

payoutChoice.title: Where you receive your share
payoutChoice.explanation: You can change this until the payout starts. Your landlord only sees that it goes to your account. The money first arrives as cash; you decide yourself whether to invest it.
payoutChoice.confirmation: I choose myself to receive my share of the deposit in my investment account. Its value can go down there.
payoutChoice.confirmBody: Your share of the deposit will then go to your investment account. You can change this until the payout starts.
payoutChoice.closed: This can no longer be changed: the payout has started or is complete.
payoutChoice.notOffered: This choice is not available for this deposit.

payoutStatus.fallback: To your own account (investing was not possible)

identity.title: Confirm your identity
identity.intro: The partner bank opens a deposit account in your name. For this, confirm your name and date of birth as on your ID.
identity.privacy: These details go to the partner bank for the legal identity check. Depiqo keeps only the result.

identityResult.opening: Your identity is confirmed; the bank is opening your account
identityResult.bank_unavailable: Your identity is confirmed, but the bank could not open the account yet. Do not pay anything yet.
identityResult.failed: Your identity could not be confirmed. Check your details.

notifType.payout_completed: Your deposit has been paid out

push.cardBody: We only send a short message, such as "Your payment has been received". Never amounts or names on your lock screen.
push.cardDenied: Notifications are off for Depiqo. You can turn them on in your phone's settings.

profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: You change your email address through Depiqo support.
profile.twoFactorHint: Turn it on on the website for extra security.
profile.biometricFailed: Biometric unlock could not be turned on.
profile.biometricUnavailable: Unlocking with Face ID or fingerprint is not possible on this device, or you have not set it up yet.
profile.logoutConfirmBody: You will be logged out on this device. Push notifications stop for this device.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Where you are logged in
devices.intro: These are the devices where you are logged in to the app. Don't recognise one? Sign it out and change your password on the website.
devices.signOutBody: {name} will be signed out and must log in again.
devices.thisDeviceBody: You will be logged out here.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: Notifications, your data, delete account
privacy.pushIntro: Choose what you want a push notification about. In the app you always see all notifications.
privacy.exportBody: Download everything Depiqo keeps about you in one file (JSON).
privacy.exportWarning: The file contains personal and financial data. Keep it somewhere safe and do not share it lightly.
privacy.deleteIntro: You can have your account deleted. We first explain what that means.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: If you delete your account, you can no longer log in. The law requires us to keep some data.
deleteAccount.confirmCheckbox: I understand that my account will be deleted permanently and that I can no longer log in.
deleteAccount.doneBody: You are logged out on all your devices.

blocker.invest_pending: Your investment account is still being opened
blocker.invest_balance: There is still money in your investment account

support.title: Help
support.subtitle: Ask Depiqo a question
support.intro: Ask Depiqo your question. Your landlord does not see your questions.
support.empty: You have not asked any questions yet.
support.askAboutDeposit: Ask a question about this deposit
support.privacyNote: Your question goes to Depiqo, not to your landlord. Do not put passwords or codes in your message.
support.subject: Subject
support.waiting: We will answer your question as soon as possible. You will get a notification.

invest.sandboxBody: You invest here with {partner}, a test partner. All amounts, prices and results are simulated.
invest.separation: Your deposit stays in the locked deposit account or wherever your landlord holds it. You invest your own money, separately from your deposit.
invest.onboardingIntro: In three steps: a short test of knowledge and experience, the terms, and choosing a portfolio.
invest.notOfferedNow: Your landlord does not offer Invest right now. New purchases are not possible; selling, withdrawing and your statements are.
invest.accountPending: The partner is opening your investment account. You will be notified as soon as you can deposit.
invest.switchPending: Everything is sold first, then the new portfolio is bought.
invest.feeProposal: From {from} to {to} per year. It only applies if you agree.
invest.chartEmpty: Not enough data for a chart yet.
invest.accruedFee: Accrued, still to pay: {amount} ({rate} per year)
invest.actions: What would you like to do
invest.depositHint: From your own account to your investment account

onboardingStep.open_account: Choose a portfolio and open the account

portfolios.title: Portfolios
portfolios.adviceNote: Depiqo gives no advice. You choose yourself.
portfolios.amountHint: The costs and examples below are for this amount.
portfolios.confirmBody: You open an investment account with the {name} portfolio at the partner.
portfolios.openedBody: The partner is opening your investment account. You will be notified as soon as you can deposit.

costs.title: Costs
costs.note: Costs in euros for this amount, if the value stays the same. Ongoing charges are included in the fund prices.

scenarios.title: Examples after 3 years
scenarios.note: These are examples, not a forecast. After costs.

appropriateness.title: Knowledge and experience
appropriateness.intro: A few questions about your knowledge and experience, so we know whether investing suits you. There are no wrong answers.
appropriateness.question: Question {n} of {total}
appropriateness.cannotAnswer: You cannot take the test right now.
appropriateness.passendBody: Based on your answers, investing matches your knowledge and experience.
appropriateness.nietPassendBody: Based on your answers, investing may not suit you. Read the reasons and the risk.
appropriateness.confirmText: I have read this warning. I understand that investing may not suit me and that I can lose money. I still want to continue.
appropriateness.alertBody: Investing may not suit you. You can lose money. Do you really want to continue?

reason.thinks_no_loss: You indicated that an investment cannot lose value. It can.
reason.cannot_bear_loss: A loss could put your rent or fixed costs at risk.
reason.short_horizon: You need this money within a year. Investing is for money you can do without for longer.
reason.goal_mismatch: Your goal does not match long-term investing.
reason.limited_knowledge: Your knowledge and experience with investing are still limited.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: Read the terms of the investment partner and of Depiqo Invest, and accept both.
terms.acceptDepiqo: I accept the Depiqo Invest terms.

depositInstr.title: Deposit money
depositInstr.intro: Transfer money to your investment account at the partner.
depositInstr.note: Transfer from an account in your own name and always include the reference. Never use your rental deposit for this.
depositInstr.sandboxBody: Test environment only. This simulates a transfer; no real money moves.

trade.title: Order
trade.intro_buy: Choose how much you want to buy. You see the costs and the risk first.
trade.intro_sell: Choose how much you want to sell. The money arrives as cash in your investment account.
trade.intro_switch: Choose your new portfolio. Everything is sold first, then the new portfolio is bought.
trade.switchNote: Until the switch is done, your current portfolio stays in place.
trade.quoteNote: You first see an overview of costs and risk. Nothing happens yet.

review.title: Check your order
review.execution_order: The partner executes your order at the next price.
review.execution_switch: Everything is sold first, then the new portfolio is bought with the proceeds.
review.expiresIn: This overview is valid for another {time}.
review.expired: This overview has expired. Request a new one.
review.ack: I have read and understood the costs and the risk. I know I can lose money.
review.noQuote: There is no order to check.
review.placedBody: The partner executes your order at the next price.

withdraw.title: Withdraw money
withdraw.intro: You can only withdraw cash to your own account, registered here.
withdraw.coolingOffUntil: For your security, you can use this account from {date}.
withdraw.registerIntro: Enter the IBAN of an account in your own name.
withdraw.codeHint: With a fresh code you can use the account at once. Without a code, only after the waiting period.
withdraw.noTwoFactor: Without two-step verification you can only use a new account after a waiting period. Turn on two-step verification on the website to speed this up.
withdraw.ibanUsableNow: Your account number is registered and can be used right away.
withdraw.ibanCoolingOff: Your account number is registered. You can use it from {date} (waiting period of {days} days).
withdraw.availableHint: Only cash can be withdrawn. Sell first if you want to withdraw more.
withdraw.doneBody: The partner transfers the money to your own account.

statements.title: Monthly statements
statements.intro: A monthly statement of your investment account, as PDF.

feeChange.title: Service fee
feeChange.note: The new fee only applies if you agree, and only from that day. Until then, your current fee applies.
feeChange.none: There is no proposal for a new fee.
feeChange.acceptText: I agree to the new service fee of {rate} per year, from today.
feeChange.accepted: Your new service fee applies from today.

validation.code6: Enter the 6 digits from your app.
validation.passwordMismatch: The passwords are not the same.
validation.date: Enter a valid date, for example 31-12-1990.
validation.messageLength: Describe your question in 10 to 4000 characters.
validation.amount: Enter a valid amount, for example 50 or 49.95.
validation.iban: This IBAN is not correct. Check the number.
